description: Panels the user can resize by dragging the line between them, or with the arrow keys after focusing the line. Mostly for dashboards.
tip: Numbers are pixels and strings are percentages, e.g. defaultSize={240} or defaultSize="30%".

vertical.title: Vertical
vertical.description: orientation="vertical" stacks the panels top to bottom.

handle.title: With handle & size limits
handle.description: withHandle shows a small grip. minSize and maxSize limit the panel size.

props.defaultSize: Starting size of the panel (px or %).
props.collapsible: The panel can fold away when dragged past minSize.
props.withHandle: Show a small grip on the line.
